department: Doctoral School of Informatics and Mathematics (ED MSTII)

deadline.value: Funded candidates apply directly on ADUM and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; the competitive contract round is separate and ran to June 2026.
deadline.quote: Apply directly. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the MSTII pages.

supervisor.value: You need a potential advisor who is HDR-accredited and attached to the school and a lab, and the advisor evaluates your application.
supervisor.quote: a potential advisor, HDR affiliated to the Doctoral School and to a research laboratory and available | Your application will be evaluated by the proposed supervisor

funding.value: The school runs a competitive selection for doctoral contracts; candidates must also apply to it for a research grant.
funding.quote: Candidates, not only for admission but also for a doctoral research grant awarded by the Doctoral School, must then apply to the Doctoral School's competitive selection process for doctoral contracts

entry_route.value: You need a master's degree or an engineering diploma, or the international equivalent.
entry_route.quote: hold a Master's degree, or an engineering diploma, or the international equivalent

notes: Early contract procedure closed 13 April 2026 and the normal round ran in May-June 2026; no 2027 date is published. Computer science is one of the four MSTII specialities.
